title: nardurus subulatus
intro: Nardurus subulatus, commonly known as Wild Valerian, is a perennial herbaceous plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anxiety and insomnia relief, as well as its antispasmodic and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Wild Valerian are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a natural remedy for stress relief. The bioactive constituents of Nardurus subulatus include valepotriates, valerenic acid, and isovaleric acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
